description: This file defines the PersistableCustomerOption class, which extends CustomerOptionEntity and implements Serializable. It manages a list of CustomerOptionDescription objects as item descriptions, serving as a data transfer object or entity within the customer attribute domain.

classes.name: PersistableCustomerOption
classes.description: Represents a customer option that is persistable, extending CustomerOptionEntity and holding a list of descriptions.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of descriptions for this customer option.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves the list of descriptions associated with this customer option.
